_comment: Hand-authored cosmetics (master plan Phase 9). Each slot attaches to a per-frame point from frame_geometry.json ('attach'), corrected by attachment_overrides.json. An item is a data entry only: id, slot, label, asset, cost, unlock_level, plus 'pivot' (which point of the item art sits on the attachment point: bottom_center, center or top_center), 'scale' (relative to the character art) and optional 'offset' [x, y] in character pixels. 'per_form' may override scale and offset for a form. Items stay empty until hat, glasses and accessory art arrives (plan §13).
